===== PG: pg_settings 关键参数 context（改法分层）=====
            name            | setting | unit |  context   | vartype 
----------------------------+---------+------+------------+---------
 autovacuum                 | on      |      | sighup     | bool
 log_min_duration_statement | -1      | ms   | superuser  | integer
 max_connections            | 100     |      | postmaster | integer
 shared_buffers             | 16384   | 8kB  | postmaster | integer
 synchronous_commit         | on      |      | user       | enum
 temp_buffers               | 1024    | 8kB  | user       | integer
 work_mem                   | 4096    | kB   | user       | integer
(7 rows)


===== PG: ALTER SYSTEM + reload（sighup 参数无需重启）=====

(1 row)

ALTER SYSTEM
      name       | setting | pending_restart

# It will be overwritten by the ALTER SYSTEM command.
